'''Larek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] Larek was investigating [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] ruins on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], particularly [[Stasis vault 113]], in which he sent several droids to recover valuable [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]]. However, the droids failed to return and Larek was forced to ask a Republic representative in the area to retrieve the cores from the droids manually.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Larek appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a hologram on Belsavis, where he begins the mission "Unheard Frequencies".
